description:
Phase 6 design task under epic `026fc832`. Designs (NOT implements) a panelized rank-revealing GF(p) PLE/LU kernel for the small-prime family (GF(7/31/127/241/251/65521)).

Parent epic: `026fc832`. Predecessor: `b0fa00af` Phase 5 scorecard's § 6 downstream-inheritance evidence shows the existing scalar PLE inherits a 4.55× speedup from the route-A wire-in but still doesn't cross 1.5× of fflas-ffpack. Closing the FAIL cells requires a dedicated panelized algorithm.

## Background

A8 rows 6-17 (pluq GF(7/251/65521) at all n/regimes), row 71 (GF(31) pluq deficient), and downstream cells (invert/solve via PLE) all require this. fflas-ffpack uses a "recursive PLUQ" (Dumas-Pernet-Sultan 2017, arXiv:1703.02438) that panelizes the matrix into MR×NR tiles and calls into the panel-GEMM fast path. gf2's current PLE is row-at-a-time scalar.

The design must address:
- Panel size selection (MR, NR, KC) consistent with the existing fp_small_panel kernel from `fc182ed5`.
- Rank-revealing behavior preserved (handle rank-deficient inputs correctly).
- How the panel kernel for elimination calls into the new shared `barrett_reduce_lane32` SSOT from `e8a0c47a`.
- Integration with `FieldMatrix::ple_in_place_window` (the current scalar API in `crates/gf2-core/src/field/ple.rs`).
- Bench cells: GF(251)/n in {256, 1024} primary; GF(7/31/127/241/65521)/n in {256, 1024}; rank-deficient regimes.
- Test surface: round-trip correctness vs the current scalar PLE for all primes × n × regimes.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] A design document attached via `jit doc add` describing the panelized PLE algorithm, panel size choice with derivation, rank-revealing pivoting strategy, and the integration mechanism with the existing `FieldMatrix::ple_in_place_window` API.
- [hard] The design lists every test required for correctness validation (per-prime proptest sweep at boundary lengths {0, 1, 15, 16, 17, 63, 64, 65}; rank-deficient cases).
- [hard] The design lists the benchmark cells that will measure speedup (matching A8 rows 6-17, 71 to verify ≥ 1.5× of fflas).
- [hard] The design names the SSOT helpers it will reuse (`barrett_reduce_lane32` from `e8a0c47a`; panel size constants from `fc182ed5`).
- [hard] No production code in this task — design only.
- [hard] The design lists the implementation child issue (single impl task) needed to land this work.

## Out of scope

- Implementation (separate child).
- Echelon, invert, solve designs — those are sibling tasks.
- GF(2^31-1) Mersenne31 PLE — that uses a different storage layout; if pursued, must be a separate design task.

## Notes

This is the foundational design — blocked echelon, invert, and solve all depend on the panelized PLE. The design must be approved before implementation dispatch.
title: Design panelized GF(p) PLE/LU kernel (026fc832 Phase 6)
